exchanges: Afternoon! I'm sitting on the bench outside the garden shed with a flask of tea.
That sounds peaceful. Are you on a break?
yes, amara gave us twenty minutes. she's very organised, she's doing a botany degree part time on top of running this place
That is a lot to juggle.
she makes me tired just watching her
Some people have endless energy.
i grew up in Swansea, by the sea, so i've always liked being outside
Growing up by the sea must have been lovely.
it was. my sister gwen and i still speak Welsh on the phone so nobody can listen in lol
A private family language is handy.
gwen's turning seventy next month and we're throwing her a party at the Legion
That will be a fun celebration.
i'm in charge of the cake, god help us
Homemade or bakery?
bakery. i'm not risking it
A wise choice.
my nephew dmitri was over yesterday, he wouldn't stop talking about Shogun, he's watched it twice
It must have really grabbed him.
and then my neighbour, also dmitri, told me he's binging Succession. two dmitris, two shows, i can't keep up
That is a lot of television recommendations at once.
i don't have time for tv in the summer anyway
The garden keeps you busy.
mariko just came over to sit with me. she's studying geology, rocks everywhere in her bag
Sounds like she brings her work everywhere.
she showed me a fossil, very cool
What kind of fossil was it?
a little shell thing. no idea
Still impressive to hold something that old.
i bought new secateurs this morning, the old ones were rusted shut
New ones make pruning so much easier.
much. oh i should say, the party for gwen isn't at the legion anymore, they double booked, so it's at the Rotary hall now
Good thing you found out in time.
yes, gwen was furious lol
Understandable, but the new place should work.
my son thabo is bringing his girlfriend Naledi to the party, we haven't met her yet
Meeting a new partner at a family party is exciting.
i'm nervous for her, our family is loud
She will probably fit right in.
next summer i want to go walking in Cornwall, gwen and i always talked about it
The coastal paths there are beautiful.
we'll be slow but we'll get there
There is no rush on a walking holiday.
the tea is cold now
Time for a refill, perhaps.
no, the flask is empty
Then it is a sign to get back to work.
amara's waving at me
Your break must be over.
before i go, what was the show my nephew is obsessed with?
back to weeding. my lawn bowling is tomorrow at least, i go every Friday
Something to look forward to after a busy day.
my knees will need it lol
A gentle game should be good for them.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your nephew Dmitri can't stop talking about Shogun.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your nephew Dmitri can't stop talking about Succession.

questions.message: which town am i from originally
where am i planning a hiking holiday
where's gwen's birthday celebration going to be
what day do i play bowls
the sun just came out, finally
what's gwen been watching on tv?
what did thabo study at school?
sorry, my nephew's show, which one was it?
